name: Flutter Kick
description: Flutter kicks are a supine endurance core exercise borrowed from swimming training in which the athlete alternately raises and lowers each leg in a small, rapid, continuous motion while keeping both legs straight and the lower back pressed to the floor. The exercise trains the hip flexors and rectus abdominis under sustained anti-extension loading across a large number of repetitions, making it a popular conditioning finisher and military fitness staple.

execution.starting_position: Lie flat on your back with arms at your sides or under the lower back for support. Legs extended, heels slightly off the floor.
execution.setup_instructions: Use a mat for comfort. Place hands under the lumbar curve if lower back arching is an issue.
steps: Step 1: Lie supine with legs straight. Press the lower back into the floor.
Step 2: Raise both feet approximately 15–30 cm off the floor.
Step 3: Rapidly alternate kicking each leg up and down in small amplitude oscillations, like swimming freestyle.
Step 4: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor throughout — if it arches, raise leg height.
Step 5: Continue for the prescribed duration or rep count.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe continuously in a relaxed rhythm throughout the set. Do not hold the breath.
common_mistakes: Allowing the lower back to arch away from the floor
Using too large an amplitude — small, rapid kicks are correct
Relaxing the leg muscles and letting the knees bend
safety_considerations: If the lower back arches despite effort, raise leg height or place hands under the lower back as a proprioceptive cue.
Not suitable during acute lower back pain flare-ups.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Legs move through a small arc of approximately 20–30 cm. The focus is speed and endurance, not amplitude.
execution.tempo_recommendations: Performed for time (20–60 seconds) or count (20–50 kicks per leg). Moderate to high speed.
coaching_cues: Press your back into the floor — there should be no gap
Quick, small kicks — not big swings
Point your toes and squeeze your quads
